DEFAULT_WL_EWALL: E-Wall. Becomes transparent when electricity is connected.
DEFAULT_WL_DTECT: Detector. Generates electricity when a particle is inside.
DEFAULT_WL_STRM: Streamline. Creates a line that follows air movement.
DEFAULT_WL_FAN: Fan. Accelerates air. Use the line tool to set direction and strength.
DEFAULT_WL_LIQD: Allows liquids, blocks all other particles. Conductive.
DEFAULT_WL_ABSRB: Absorbs particles but lets air currents through.
DEFAULT_WL_AIR: Allows air, but blocks all particles.
DEFAULT_WL_POWDR: Allows powders, blocks all other particles.
DEFAULT_WL_CNDTR: Conductor. Allows all particles to pass through and conducts electricity.
DEFAULT_WL_EHOLE: E-Hole. absorbs particles, releases them when powered.
DEFAULT_WL_GAS: Allows gases, blocks all other particles.
DEFAULT_WL_GRVTY: Gravity wall. Newtonian Gravity has no effect inside a box drawn with this.
DEFAULT_WL_ENRGY: Allows energy particles, blocks all other particles.
DEFAULT_WL_NOAIR: Allows all particles, but blocks air.
DEFAULT_WL_STASIS: Freezes particles inside the wall in place until powered.
